service.title: Service
intro: Service tab. Keep every service record in one place.
scenes: Tap Service. You'll see your totals, and when your next service is due.
To add one, tap Add service. The date and kilometres are already filled in.
Pick the service type, then search for your service centre.
Tap everything that was done, and add the cost.
Attach a photo or a PDF of the bill, and save.
Tap any service to see it, open the bill, or edit it.
To delete one, open it and tap Delete.

mileage.title: Mileage
intro: Mileage tab. Know your real kilometres per litre.
scenes: Tap Mileage. Your average, best tank, and cost per kilometre are on top.
New to it? Fill the tank full, reset Trip A, and note it at the next full fill-up.
Tap Add fuel. Enter the litres, the amount, and your Trip A reading.
See how you compare with other warriors, and get tips for better mileage.
The chart shows your spends and mileage, by week, month, or year.
Tap any fill-up to fix it, or delete it.

motomart.title: Motomart
motomart.tag: Buy and sell used riding gear
intro: Motomart. Buy and sell used riding gear within RWB.
scenes: Tap Motomart. Search, or pick a category.
Tap an item for photos and details, then message the seller on WhatsApp.
To sell, tap Sell something, and add up to five photos.
Add the name, condition, and price. The RWB team approves it, usually within a day.
Your posts are under My posts. Share them, or mark them as sold.
Open your post to edit it, or delete it.

guides.title: Guides
intro: Guides. Maintenance help and tested gear, from RWB.
scenes: Tap Guides. Maintenance has how-to guides from our coordinators.
Search with any keyword, like chain, or brakes.
Tap a guide to read it right here, or download it.
Switch to Accessories for gear tested and rated by RWB. Filter, or sort by price.
Tap View product to open it in the store.
Can't find something? Ask Pookie, our RWB AI.

events.title: Events
intro: Events. Rides, meet-ups, and shared expenses.
scenes: Tap Events to see upcoming rides. Tap one for the details.
Tap Going, Maybe, or Can't go.
Share it on WhatsApp, add it to your calendar, or open the map.
Paid for the group? Tap Add expense, and choose who to split it with.
Settle up shows the fewest payments to clear everyone.
Only the person who added an expense can edit or delete it.

me.title: Me
intro: Your profile. Make the app your own.
scenes: Tap your photo at the top right to open your profile.
Tap the camera to add a profile photo.
Tap Edit to update your details, then Save.
Choose light, dark, or auto.
Turn on notifications, and choose which ones you want.
Pick which WhatsApp opens links, and choose if you appear on the leaderboards.
The privacy policy and Sign out are at the bottom.

crew.title: RWB
intro: The RWB tab. Our members, and our leaderboards.
scenes: Tap the big RWB logo in the middle of the bottom bar.
Check the three leaderboards: Mileage, Service, and Road Warriors.
The RWB team is pinned on top. Call or WhatsApp them in any emergency.
Search by name, place, or bike number. Spotted a Ronin on the road? Type their number plate.
Prefer privacy? Hide yourself from the leaderboards in your profile. Phone numbers stay hidden.

staff.title: Team tools
scenes: Approve Motomart posts. Check the photos and price, then approve or reject.
Admins approve join requests from Admin, in the profile.
Tap New in the RWB tab, and add new members to WhatsApp.
Tap a member to edit them, or make them a coordinator.
Remove from RWB, with a reason and a note.
Removed members stay under Left or removed, and can be restored.
Create events, and every member is notified.
Send announcements from the bell.
And check birthdays in Admin.
